scope: Saved development measurements, 30 checkpoints in four dataset-architecture cells. This extraction does not rerun models, fitting, matching, or null sampling.

definitions.alignment: Spearman correlation of footprint overlap with classwise KL-profile cosine, minus the magnitude-plus-node-role baseline correlation.
definitions.basis_contrast: Per checkpoint: channel alignment minus the median alignment of its five rotations. Summaries use the median of checkpoint contrasts.
definitions.amplification: Stored checkpoint medians are log2 learned/null field-mass ratios. Exponentiate the pooled median log2 value, rather than averaging ratios.
definitions.seed_gain: Matched-matrix Pearson correlation minus the median of identically matched row-shuffled surrogates; checkpoint values aggregate partner comparisons.
definitions.e7a: Stratified cross-seed Pearson conservation gain over identically matched surrogates.
definitions.e7b: Within-checkpoint Spearman agreement of exact and approximate signed effects, minus median Spearman agreement after shuffling attribution within the stratum. It is a difference of correlations, NOT a raw correlation, and may exceed one.
definitions.strata: Two magnitude-ranked halves of nonzero edge strengths. Stratum 0 is the head and stratum 1 is the tail.
definitions.functional_gain: Classwise-KL-profile cosine of edge-matched channels minus median cosine under a mass-stratified permutation of their assignment.
definitions.curves: Cumulative sorted edge-strength mass, linearly interpolated at 201 rank fractions. Curves summarize each checkpoint before cell medians are taken.
definitions.additivity_residual: For each target channel, L1 discrepancy between simultaneous source ablation and summed separate source ablations, divided by simultaneous-ablation L1 mass. Stored checkpoint statistic is the median over target channels.

example.selection: Checkpoint nearest to the pooled median signed-effect Spearman correlation; ties broken by checkpoint hash.
